invite.existingAccount: You already have an account. Sign in to add this business to it.
invite.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Nobody else will ever see it.
invite.useMagicLink: No password — email me sign-in links instead
invite.checkEmail: You've joined. We've sent a sign-in link to {email} — open it on this device to continue.

invalid.body: Check you opened the latest invitation email, or ask your manager to resend it.

revoked.body: Ask your manager if you think this is a mistake.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.createBusinessHint: The owner receives an invitation email and sets up the business themselves.
admin.deletionRequestsHint: Nothing has been deleted: erasing an account is a supervised step. Businesses must keep payroll records for staff who worked for them.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.subtitle: Your manager needs these details before you can use the app. Only managers who can edit staff see your address and date of birth.
profile.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. You'll type it every time you clock in or out. Don't share it.
profile.setPinSubtitle: Your PIN was reset by a manager. Choose a new one to continue.

setup.title: Set up your business
setup.subtitle: Four quick steps. You can change everything later in Settings.

stepTitles.payPeriod: How often do you pay staff?

setup.anchor: First day of a pay period
setup.anchorHint: Any past or future start date; periods repeat from it.
setup.rolesHint: These roles were created for you, most senior first. You can rename them, change permissions or add your own in Settings → Roles.
setup.permissions: {count, plural, =0 {No management permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
setup.fixStep: Something on the {step} step needs fixing.

location.name: Location name

modeHint.required: Punches from outside the radius are refused. Poor GPS accuracy is accepted and flagged, never refused.
modeHint.warn: Punches from outside are accepted and flagged for review.
modeHint.off: No location check. Kiosk punches never use GPS.

location.geoUnsupported: This browser can't share its location.
location.geoDenied: Location permission was denied. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
location.geoFailed: Couldn't get a position. Try again outdoors or near a window.
location.temporaryHint: For catering or event sites used for a short time.
location.mapLabel: Map: tap to place the location's centre

test.intro: Stand where staff clock in (the kitchen, the back door, the bar) and take ten readings. We'll recommend a radius that would accept all of them.
test.unsupported: This browser can't share its location.
test.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
test.explain: The farthest reading plus its reported accuracy was {worst} m; the recommendation adds a 10% margin.

payRules.responsibilityBody: The app calculates exactly what you set here. It does not check them against employment law, and matching current local law is the owner's responsibility.
payRules.presetFrom: Starting values were pre-filled from the {preset} preset. Check each one before confirming.
payRules.overtimeOrder: Daily overtime is calculated first; hours already paid as daily overtime are not counted again toward the weekly threshold. Where tiers overlap, the higher multiplier applies once.
payRules.minimumDailyPayHint: If someone reports for work but works less, pay this many hours.
payRules.splitShiftSpanHint: Warn when one person's shifts on one day span longer than this.
payRules.vacationPercentHint: Accrued on gross wages of each approved timesheet.
payRules.confirm: I've reviewed these values. I understand the app calculates what it is told and that matching local employment law is my responsibility.

people.title: People
people.inviteSubtitle: They'll get an email link to create their own account. You never set or see their password.
people.name: Name
people.resetPinHint: They'll be asked to choose a new PIN next time they open the app.
people.deactivateHint: Access ends immediately: sign-in, PIN, messages and schedule. They stay in timesheets, reports and exports for any period they worked, so their final pay is still calculated.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Who can do what. Lower rank number = more senior; people can only act for more junior ranks.
roles.name: Role name
roles.summary: Who can do what, by rank.

business.title: Business settings
business.description: Business info, request rules and time clock rules.
business.name: Business name
business.minorAgeHint: People younger than this are treated as minors. Seeded for your province; check it.
business.burdenHint: Optional. If set, schedules also show an estimated loaded cost = wages × (1 + this %).
business.burdenNoteHint: Shown in the tooltip, e.g. "CPP, EI, WSIB and 4% vacation pay".
business.dirPhone: Show phone numbers in the staff directory
business.dirEmail: Show email addresses in the staff directory
business.selfApproval: Allow approvers to approve their own requests
business.selfApprovalHint: Every self-approval is audited. Blackouts, notice and conflict checks still apply.
business.modePersonal: Staff clock in on their own phone
business.modeKiosk: Shared kiosk tablet at the location
business.early: Allow clock-in up to (minutes before shift)
business.unscheduledHint: They are always flagged for review.
business.maxShiftHint: The entry stays open — no end time is ever invented.
business.skew: Reject offline punches more than (minutes) ahead of server time
business.skewHint: Guards against a device clock set forward.
business.workDayStartHint: A shift belongs to the work-day of its clock-in. 04:00 means a 21:00–02:10 close counts as the day it started.
business.roundingWarning: Rounding is off by default. Rounding that doesn't favour employees systematically shaves paid time; choosing it is the owner's legal risk. Raw punch times are always kept.
business.roundFavour: In the employee's favour (clock-in down, clock-out up)
business.summary: Business info, request rules and time clock rules.
business.autoGroups: Group chats per location and position
business.autoGroupsHint: Kept in sync with who works where.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Departments and roles on the floor. Set a minimum age where the law or your policy needs one (the business minor threshold is {age}).
positions.name: Name
positions.emptyBody: Add the jobs people do here (Server, Cook…) so shifts, wages and pickups can use them.

blackouts.title: Blackout dates
blackouts.summary: Dates when time off can't be requested.
blackouts.description: Staff see the reason as soon as they pick a blocked date — not as a denial days later.
blackouts.emptyBody: Time off can be requested for any date.

kiosks.title: Kiosk devices
kiosks.description: Each kiosk has its own identity, bound to one location. Revoke a lost or retired device here.

account.title: Account
account.changePinHint: This PIN is only used at {business}.
account.reauthOnly: To confirm it's you, sign in again with an email link first.
account.reauthSent: Check your email, open the link, then change your PIN within 10 minutes.
account.myDataHint: Download a copy of your profile, wages, shifts, requests, time entries and the messages you sent, for every business you belong to. Messages other people sent you are listed without their text.
account.deleteAccountHint: The platform administrator removes your sign-in and personal details. Businesses you worked for keep the payroll records the law requires them to keep (hours, pay, time entries). Download your data first if you want a copy.
account.confirmDeletion: Send a deletion request for your whole account, in every business you belong to? You can cancel it until it has been processed.
account.deletionRequested: You asked for your account to be deleted on {date}. The platform administrator will process it.

wages.appendOnly: Wage changes are added with an effective date; past pay is never rewritten. A raise dated mid-period takes effect from the next pay period.
wages.effectiveHint: Can't fall inside an approved pay period.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.noUpcomingBody: Published shifts for the next five weeks appear here.
schedule.addToCalendarHint: Subscribe from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. The link is private: it shows only your own published shifts.
schedule.feedRotateHint: Creating a new link stops the old one working.
schedule.noLocationsBody: Ask a manager to assign you to a location.
schedule.burdenDefault: Wages × (1 + {percent}%) payroll burden. Set what it covers in Settings → Business.
schedule.missingWage: {count, plural, one {# shift has} other {# shifts have}} no wage on file
schedule.publishBody: {count, plural, one {# draft shift} other {# draft shifts}} will become visible. Only staff whose own shifts changed are notified.
schedule.publishWarnings: {count, plural, one {# shift has warnings} other {# shifts have warnings}}
schedule.publishAnyway: Warnings don't block publishing — publish anyway if these are deliberate.
schedule.breakHint: Planning only — pay uses actual break punches, never this number.
schedule.warningsHint: You can still save — warnings stay on the shift until resolved.
schedule.offsiteHint: For catering, deliveries or a temporary kitchen. Punches under an override are flagged OFFSITE and keep the captured position.
schedule.templatesHint: Reusable shift times. Pick one when adding a shift.
schedule.notEligible: Not normally eligible for this shift: {reasons}. You can still assign them.

warnings.overtimeDay: Overtime risk: {hours} h scheduled this day (threshold {threshold} h)
warnings.overtimeWeek: Overtime risk: {hours} h scheduled this week (threshold {threshold} h)
warnings.shortRest: Only {hours} h rest between shifts (minimum {minimum} h)
warnings.splitShift: Shifts span {hours} h this day (maximum {maximum} h)
warnings.underAge: Below the minimum age for this position ({age}; needs {minimum})

requests.blackoutsTitle: Time off can't be requested on:
requests.availabilityPending: Your change from {date} is waiting for approval.
requests.noShiftRequests: No pending drops, pickups or swaps.
requests.noAvailableBody: Open and dropped shifts you're eligible for appear here.
requests.swapHint: Only coworkers who could work your shift — and whose shift you could work — are listed.
requests.noSwapCandidates: No eligible swaps in the two weeks around this shift.

clock.title: Time clock
clock.allMyHoursHint: Your own hours at every business you work for. Only you can see this view.
clock.forgotIn: Clock out (I forgot to clock in)
clock.queuedOffline: You're offline. The punch is saved on this device and will be sent when you reconnect.
clock.queuedCount: {count, plural, one {# punch} other {# punches}} waiting to be sent — keep this page open or come back when you're online.
clock.synced: Offline punch sent. A manager will confirm it.
clock.syncFailed: An offline punch couldn't be recorded: {error}
clock.locationDenied: Location permission is off. On iPhone: Settings → Privacy → Location Services → your browser → While Using. On Android: tap the lock icon in the address bar → Permissions → Location → Allow. Then try again.
clock.previousTitle: When did your last shift finish?
clock.previousBody: You clocked in at {since} and never clocked out. We don't guess — tell us when you actually finished.
clock.previousHint: This goes to a manager to confirm. It doesn't count as a punch.
clock.answerSent: Sent. You can clock in now.
clock.forgotMessage: I forgot to clock out. This is when I finished.
clock.staleAnswered: Your earlier missing clock-out is waiting for a manager to confirm.
clock.locationNote: Your position is checked when you clock in and out. Browser GPS can be imprecise; unusual punches are flagged for review, not refused.
clock.noHistory: This entry has never been edited.
clock.missingShift: I worked a shift that isn't here
clock.correctionHint: Tell your manager the right times. They'll review it — you can't edit your own time.

timeclock.title: Time clock review
timeclock.description: Who's working, and anything that needs a human decision before pay is calculated.
timeclock.unresolvedHint: Red flags block timesheet approval until resolved. Every resolution needs a reason and is audited.

kiosk.title: Kiosk
kiosk.notEnrolledBody: A manager can set it up from Settings → Kiosk devices.
kiosk.managerPin: {name}, enter your manager PIN to leave kiosk mode
kiosk.previousOpen: You have an unfinished shift. Open the app on your phone to say when it finished.
kiosk.exitHint: A manager taps their name and enters their PIN.
kiosk.enrolTitle: Set up this device as a kiosk
kiosk.enrolBody: The kiosk gets its own identity. It can only list staff names and record punches. You'll be signed out of this device when setup finishes.
kiosk.enrolNone: You need permission to edit clock entries to set up a kiosk.
kiosk.enrolWarning: Leaving kiosk mode later needs a manager's PIN.
kiosk.enrol: Turn this device into a kiosk

payRulesPage.title: Pay rules
payRulesPage.responsibilityTitle: These values are the owner's responsibility
payRulesPage.responsibilityBody: The app calculates exactly what it is told to calculate here. It does not check these values against employment law and does not claim compliance on your behalf. Seeded presets are a starting point you must confirm.
payRulesPage.workDayHint: An entry belongs whole to the work-day (and pay period) of its clock-in. With 04:00, a 21:00–02:10 close counts as the day it started.
payRulesPage.breaksHint: If a break rule isn't met, the entry is flagged BREAK_MISSED and must be resolved ("taken, add it" or "missed, pay it") before approval. Actual break punches are what's deducted — never the planned break.
payRulesPage.breakRule: After {hours} h in a row, a {minutes}-minute break
payRulesPage.holidaysHint: Worked → those hours are paid at the holiday's total rate (×1.5 = time and a half in all). Not worked → an average day's pay if the employee passes this test.
payRulesPage.minWorked: Days worked in the lookback, at least
payRulesPage.averageNotSet: Not set — holiday pay won't be calculated
payRulesPage.averageDaysWorked: Straight-time wages in the window ÷ days worked
payRulesPage.averageFixed: Straight-time wages in the window ÷ a fixed number
payRulesPage.averageHint: The spec doesn't fix this formula, so you choose it. Ontario's rule is ÷20 over the 4 weeks before; BC's is ÷ days worked over the 30 days before.
payRulesPage.premiumRequiresEligibility: Working a holiday earns the premium only if the employee passes this test (otherwise regular pay)

holidaysPage.title: Holidays
holidaysPage.description: Statutory holidays show on the schedule and get their own payroll columns.
holidaysPage.name: Name
holidaysPage.emptyBody: Add this year's provincial statutory holidays with the button above, or add your own.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.blockingFlags: {count, plural, one {# blocking flag} other {# blocking flags}}
timesheets.cantCalculateTitle: This timesheet can't be calculated until the owner decides a rule the app won't guess:
timesheets.blockingTitle: {count, plural, one {# unresolved entry blocks approval} other {# unresolved entries block approval}}
timesheets.salaried: Salaried: paid a fixed amount per period, excluded from overtime.
timesheets.holidayEligible: Didn't work — eligible for holiday pay
timesheets.holidayInputs: Employed {employed} days (needs {minEmployed}); worked {worked} days between {from} and {to} (needs {minWorked}).
timesheets.ownerExceptionsHint: {count, plural, one {# blocking flag is} other {# blocking flags are}} unresolved. As Owner you may approve with exceptions; each one is written to the audit log.
timesheets.managerBlockedHint: {count, plural, one {# blocking flag must} other {# blocking flags must}} be resolved before you can approve.
timesheets.approveHint: Approving locks this person's entries for the period. Later changes need an Owner and are audited.

reports.title: Reports
reports.empty: Nothing to report for this period.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.prefsHint: You always get these in the app. Turn off the emails you don't want.

messages.title: Messages
messages.noChatsBody: Start a chat with a coworker.
messages.requireConfirmation: Ask people to confirm they've read it
messages.tooBig: Images can be up to 5 MB.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page needs a connection. The time clock still works offline: punches are saved on this device and sent when you're back online.
